title: ClientMessage
description: Every message a client may send on the game WebSocket. The server rejects anything that does not validate. The socket is authenticated at connect time (Supabase JWT); messages carry no identity.

StartGame.description: Host only. Moves the room from lobby to the first board.

SetDisplayName.description: Lobby only. Renames the sender in this room; the server adds a suffix when the name is taken.

SetHostPlays.description: Host only, lobby only. Joins or leaves the game as a contestant on the host device.

LeaveRoom.description: Lobby only, not the host. Removes the sender from the room.

SelectClue.description: Sent by the player who has control of the board.

ReadingDone.description: Host only. The host device finished reading the active clue aloud, so buzzing can open.

Buzz.description: clientSentAt is advisory only; the server orders buzzes by its own receive time, with lockout for early buzzes.

AnswerProgress.description: The answering player's interim transcript, so the TV can show it live. The server drops more than 4 per second. In final_answer it is instead the sender's private draft of their typed answer: kept by the server, never relayed, and submitted for them if time runs out. Clients debounce drafts and always send the last one.

source.description: voice for every clue and Daily Double; typed only in final_answer (Final Schmegettes answers are typed).

SubmitWager.description: Daily Double or Final round wager, in whole dollars. The server checks the range: Daily Double $5 to max(score, round's top value); Final $0 to score. The first valid wager locks.

OverrideVerdict.description: Host only. Replaces the verdict on one answer of the clue just played, or of the Final answer being revealed.

OverrideReview.description: Host only. Opens or closes the review of a verdict on the clue just played (or the Final answer being revealed). While open, the clock is paused.

Rematch.description: Host only, once the game is finished: everyone still in the room goes back to the lobby for a new game.
